user_visible_currency_rule: Final Excel may show only CNY/¥ or EUR/€. China-market prices remain CNY. All non-CNY evidence used in the workbook is converted to EUR at export time using a dated FX reference; original foreign currency remains only in the internal evidence chain.
source_market_rule: Converted EUR values retain their original source-market label and evidence status; conversion never upgrades a foreign anchor into a China RMB price band.
excel_gate: Run pre-Excel audit after applying the CNY/EUR-only display rule.
